title: "00 · Environment check"
execute:
  enabled: false
---

Nothing is analyzed here. The notebook checks that the kernel really is Blender,
that `city2graph` is installed inside it, and that the SciGraphs operators are
registered; a last cell puts a cube in the 3D viewport, which proves the kernel
and Blender are one process. It also shows the quirk the rest of the sequence
depends on: the working directory is Blender's, not the notebook's, so the
helpers in `notebooks/tools/` are found through the extension's `notebook_dir`
preference.

No network access needed. Run it first.
